evidence: Labeled RPC/REST/ZMQ and implements the `setprunelock` and `listprunelocks` RPC methods in src/rpc/blockchain.cpp.
rationale: Adds new RPC methods to resolve an interface gap where external wallets and indexers cannot protect required blocks from being pruned during disconnections. Reviewers note this is directly needed to support external indexers like electrs and downstream wallet software running against pruned nodes without risking rescan failures.
